scams.name: SIM Card Data Shortchange
scams.setup: Airport kiosk sells a SIM card advertised at a high data allowance (e.g. 20GB).
scams.mechanism: Only a fraction (e.g. 5GB) is actually loaded, or a short-lived trial/shared plan is used; discovered days later when data runs out.
scams.countermeasure: Check data balance via the carrier's own USSD/app code immediately after purchase, before leaving the kiosk.

scams.name: Security 'Special Treatment' Tip Solicitation
scams.setup: Security staff offer to skip a step (shoes off, extra bin) as a 'favor.'
scams.mechanism: Manufactures a fake privilege to justify a tip request from an official-looking source, which raises compliance.
scams.countermeasure: Decline politely; official procedures don't require tips. This is a low-stakes, low-severity nuisance rather than a real security process.

scams.name: Equipment Confiscation Threat
scams.setup: Officials flag a GoPro/microphone/camera as 'professional equipment' requiring a fee to pass.
scams.mechanism: Fear of losing gear pressures quick payment rather than dispute.
scams.countermeasure: Ask for a written/official receipt for any fee; legitimate customs fees are documented, informal ones usually aren't.

scams.name: Forced Luggage Assistance
scams.setup: A handler grabs bags before being asked and carries them a short distance.
scams.mechanism: Reciprocity pressure - service was rendered without consent, so a tip feels owed.
scams.countermeasure: Firmly hold onto your own luggage; state 'no, thank you' immediately rather than after the fact.
